B. Ethics of rights and justice, Egoism, Deontological
C. Egoism, Utilitarianism, Deontological
D. Utilitarianism, Ethics of duty, Relativist

F. Ethics of rights and justice, Utilitarianism, Virtue
G. Ethics of duty, Ethics of rights and justice, Principle

I. Ethics of duty, Utilitarianism, Consequentialist
J. Ethics of duty, Egoism, Virtue

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
